title: 2 charts: SpaceX closes $60B acquisition of Cursor
excerpt: The second-largest acquisition of a venture-backed company on record is official. Cursor, the fast-growing agentic coding startup, is now a part of SpaceX af...
content_html:
Jacob Robbins, Stephanie Zhu

Fri, August 14, 2026 at 7:19 PM EDT 2 min read

The second-largest acquisition of a venture-backed company on record is official.

Cursor, the fast-growing agentic coding startup, is now a part of SpaceX after the space giant led by Elon Musk completed its $60 billion all-stock acquisition Friday. The deal pairs one of the fastest-growing startups with SpaceX's vast—and expensive to run—infrastructure-centric xAI division. The latter has its sights set on improving its AI service offerings and is betting big on agentic coding to get there.

"Cursor turns SpaceX's xAI investment from an infrastructure bet into a vertically integrated enterprise platform," said Harrison Rolfes, a senior research analyst at PitchBook who covers the major AI frontier labs. "Without Cursor, SpaceX owns expensive compute and a model seeking distribution."

The deal also gives some of Cursor's biggest backers more exposure to Musk's companies. Andreessen Horowitz, for instance, which backed two of SpaceX's other acquisitions, X and xAI, is getting an additional dip into SpaceX stock via its investment in Cursor.

Cursor's behemoth acquisition is dwarfed only by SpaceX's takeover of xAI in February. That merger valued the frontier lab at $250 billion and brought all of Elon Musk's "X" companies under one umbrella. But the addition of xAI into the fold has been an expensive endeavor for SpaceX, which has seen its AI costs balloon capital expenditure.

Wiz had previously set the record for the largest acquisition of a VC-backed company when it sold to Alphabet for $32 billion. It had also long held the record for the fastest-growing startup, reaching $100 million ARR in 18 months. Cursor beat that record as well when it reached the same revenue milestone in only 12 months.

Using PitchBook and publicly available data, the charts below put into context Cursor's meteoric rise, mapping how it keeps growing rapidly and comparing the acquisition against its VC peers.

雅各布·罗宾斯、斯蒂芬妮·朱

2026 年 8 月 14 日星期五，美国东部时间晚上 7:19 阅读 2 分钟

有记录以来第二大风险投资支持公司收购正式完成。

埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 领导的太空巨头周五完成了 600 亿美元的全股票收购，Cursor 是一家快速发展的代理编码初创公司，现已成为 SpaceX 的一部分。 这笔交易将增长最快的初创公司之一与 SpaceX 庞大且运营成本高昂的以基础设施为中心的 xAI 部门结合起来。 后者的目标是改善其人工智能服务产品，并在代理编码上投入巨资以实现这一目标。

PitchBook 负责主要 AI 前沿实验室的高级研究分析师 Harrison Rolfes 表示：“Cursor 将 SpaceX 的 xAI 投资从基础设施投资转变为垂直整合的企业平台。” “如果没有 Cursor，SpaceX 将拥有昂贵的计算能力和寻求分发的模型。”

订阅 The Daily Pitch 时事通讯

这笔交易还让 Cursor 的一些最大支持者有更多机会接触马斯克的公司。 例如，Andreessen Horowitz 支持了 SpaceX 的另外两项收购，即 X 和 xAI，通过对 Cursor 的投资，进一步下跌了 SpaceX 的股票。

Cursor 的巨额收购与 SpaceX 在 2 月份收购 xAI 相比显得相形见绌。 这次合并使前沿实验室的估值达到了 2500 亿美元，并将埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的所有“X”公司纳入了一个保护伞之下。 但对于 SpaceX 来说，将 xAI 纳入其中是一项昂贵的努力，该公司的人工智能成本已经大幅增加。

Wiz 此前曾以 320 亿美元将其出售给 Alphabet，创下了风投支持公司最大的收购记录。 它还长期保持着增长最快的初创公司的记录，在 18 个月内达到了 1 亿美元的 ARR。 Cursor 也打破了这一记录，仅用了 12 个月就达到了同样的收入里程碑。

使用 PitchBook 和公开数据，下面的图表展示了 Cursor 的迅速崛起，描绘了它如何保持快速增长，并将此次收购与其他风险投资同行进行了比较。
